rev: Retail/Wholesale Food Establishment Plan Review Application (SUDP health application, accessible)
notes: Denver Development Services' retail and wholesale food establishment plan review application. Lists that say 'check all that apply' take every item that applies, by name. Equipment and fixture counts take a number each. Tables take one row per line, the columns separated by commas, as the hints show; sink dimensions go in as length, width and depth. The building submittal checklists on pages 2 and 3, the date, and the certification box are left for the applicant; the type-of-establishment boxes in this PDF are named out of step with their printed labels, so each label is paired with the box beside it.
